name: CervixAgent fixed three-phase research workflow
source: QB-20260630-1 山东大学宫颈癌方案报告专业.docx

implementation.reason: No licensed Schrodinger installation is currently available.

requires_confirmation: Exact SMARTS definitions for every Michael acceptor class
Compound standardization, tautomer, stereochemistry and protonation rules
Open-source covalent docking reaction mapping and search parameters
Integrated ranking weights and tie-break rules
MD replicate count and detailed simulation parameters
Experimental data file schemas and sample identifiers

phases.name: CervixAgent construction and electrophilic natural-product virtual screening

steps.name: Initialize project, environment and immutable run records
Ingest ECNPDB, COCONUT and LOTUS compound data
Build CervixKG and GraphRAG literature evidence index
Apply Michael acceptor, Lipinski and PAINS primary filters
Prepare HPV16 E6 and IDO1 target structures
Run dual-target covalent docking with the recorded legal engine
Integrate docking and literature evidence and rank candidates
Run 50 ns GROMACS MD for TOP5 candidates
Freeze and export TOP20 candidates
Import TOP20 cytotoxicity, p53 and Kyn/Trp screening data
Select and approve TOP5 candidates
Import alkyne-probe, click-chemistry and LC-MS/MS evidence
Import HPV E6-p53 axis validation evidence
Import IDO1 enzyme, Kyn/Trp and CETSA evidence
Import TAM and CD8 T-cell functional evidence
Approve the candidate entering TC-1 validation

phases.name: TC-1 combination-treatment validation and CC-IRS modeling

steps.name: Create the fixed TC-1 study data package and identifiers
Import tumor growth, survival and complete-response data
Import TIL, IHC, Kyn/Trp and RNA-seq data
Build and evaluate the CC-IRS random-forest model
Generate final datasets, reports, code and audit package
